prompts.name: castle-cliffs
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The attached image is the approved v6 composition and stippling style reference. Create ONLY layer 5, the cliffs and castle, for a browser-composited scene. Transparent PNG, full 1536x1024 canvas, same coordinates as reference: dark compact crenellated castle at x=1140 to1300,y=110 to310; castle gate and zigzag stone road down the cliff face; sheer cliff mass from x=900 to1536, bottom ending near y=655 (64% canvas height), a few attached pines allowed. Preserve the detailed fine monochrome stipple, black silhouette, moonlit white stone edges and dark cliff fissures. COMPLETE the castle geometry obscured by other objects, but KEEP its shape and position. Everything outside the castle/cliff silhouette must be truly transparent alpha, including the whole left half, all sky behind battlements and pines, the upper sky and lower water. Retain opaque BLACK interior shadows within the cliff and castle (black is part of the subject). No moon, stars, clouds, lake, reflection, background mountains, foreground tree, rocks, reeds, characters, UI or text. Do not render a composite scene or checkerboard; this is an isolated full-canvas registration-aligned cutout.

prompts.name: mountains-trees
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset: independent distant mountains and trees layer, transparent PNG 1536x1024. The first reference is the approved full v6 scene; the isolated castle is only for consistency and must NOT appear. Reconstruct ONLY the background mountains and distant pine forests across the entire canvas width, filling areas previously hidden by castle and foreground tree. Keep v6's sharp mountain ridges, layered pine silhouettes, white stippled valley fog, and extremely fine 1985 Macintosh monochrome pen-and-ink texture. Composition: transparent sky for top 32% of canvas; jagged mountain tops roughly y=355 to460; forest bands around y=480 to620; misty horizontal distant lake shoreline at y=655. Below shoreline use opaque black fill to bottom (will be covered by separate water). All sky above the mountain silhouette must be genuine transparent alpha; internal mountain shadows and trees are opaque black. Do NOT include stars, moon, clouds, castle, cliff, path, lake surface, reflection, foreground tree, rocks, reeds, people, text, UI, or checkerboard. No fuzzy halo around the mountain contour. Preserve scale and horizon of the composition reference.

prompts.name: foreground
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Produce ONLY the foreground layer of the first reference image (the complete approved v6 scene), at 1536x1024 with genuine transparent background. Other references are isolated layers for the same project. Preserve fine black-and-white Macintosh stippling, dense black silhouettes, white rim-lit roots and stones. Foreground consists of the large bare gnarled tree trunk at far left with delicate branches extending from x0 to430,y100 to570; boulders, ground and grasses at lower left from x0,y600 to x700,y1024; a smaller right foreground bank with rocks and reeds/cattails from x1250,y740 to bottom-right corner. Branch gaps MUST be transparent so a sky/moon/mountains layer can show between them. Center of canvas and all visible water areas must be entirely transparent; black should remain opaque only inside tree/rock/land silhouettes. No sky glow, moon, clouds, mountains, distant trees, castle, cliffs, path, lake, water reflections, text, border, checkerboard, or people. Keep exact canvas registration and don't center or enlarge the foreground subjects. Include hidden roots fully for compositing. Crisp silhouette boundaries with no fuzzy glow.

prompts.name: moon
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: standalone full moon for a finely stippled black-and-white 1985 Macintosh castle landscape. Produce a square 1024x1024 transparent PNG. A single perfectly round white full moon centered at (512,512), diameter 920px, covered with fine black stippled craters and darker maria. Flat monochrome pen-and-ink illustration matching antique Macintosh 1-bit art, tiny consistent dots rather than chunky pixels, with large calm white regions. Entire lunar disc opaque. Outside the circular moon is completely transparent alpha. No halo, outer glow, black disc behind it, stars, sky, clouds, scenery, architecture, text, border or checkerboard. The moon is complete and unobstructed for placement behind a castle layer.

prompts.name: clouds
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: separate transparent cloud ribbon for a black-and-white finely stippled Macintosh castle scene. Wide 1536x1024 transparent PNG. Draw a few extremely thin low horizontal wisps of night cloud, gently curled, contained ONLY in the central strip y=360 to620, thinning to fully transparent at the far left and far right. Huge transparent margins above and below. Fine black-and-white stippled edges and mostly transparent gaps, opaque charcoal-black small cloud cores where appropriate so the clouds can visibly pass in front of a bright moon. Very restrained WHITE dustlike stipple on upper edges only. Not gray photographic smoke, no smooth blurry gradients, no puffy cumulus masses. No moon, stars, scenery, mountains, text, background color, checkerboard, border or glow. Actual transparent alpha required. This asset drifts left to right over 3 minutes, with all other scenery in independent layers.

prompts.name: lake
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: independent lake surface plate for a 1985 Macintosh castle landscape, 1536x1024 landscape PNG. Draw ONLY open water covering every pixel edge to edge: a nearly black moonlit lake viewed at a shallow angle, delicately stippled narrow horizontal silver ripples and broken reflections. Perspective: extremely tightly packed fine horizontal lines at top, gradually wider lines toward bottom. A broken shimmering moon reflection centered about x=1080 (70% of width), thin at top and slightly widening toward bottom; all other water considerably darker. Reflect a few distant vertical dark shapes only as abstract broken bands, no recognizable mirrored buildings. Match finely detailed monochrome pen and ink stippling, not photographic gray water or chunky pixels. No sky, moon disc, mountains, trees, shoreline, cliffs, castle, rocks, reeds, foreground land, text, border or transparent areas. This is ONLY the water plate: the site will position it below the shoreline and independently composite foreground land on top.

prompts.name: moon-simple
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent PNG game-art asset, square. A very simple flat white full-moon disc with only a few loose small clusters of black stipple along the lower-left rim. 1985 Macintosh 1-bit game illustration, NOT a realistic astronomical moon: NO recognizable lunar geography, NO realistic crater rings, NO detailed maria, NO photographic shading. At least 90% of the disc is plain solid white. Circle centered and entirely within square canvas with 6% transparent margin. Fine irregular tiny black dots in the few rim clusters; clean smooth circle edge. Genuine transparent alpha outside disc. No glow, halo, stars, clouds, scenery, text, checkerboard or border. The result should read as a simple luminous white circle when shown 300 pixels wide behind a dark castle.
prompts.revision: User: original moon too realistic; use restrained game-art markings.

prompts.name: moon-reference
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Create a standalone transparent PNG moon asset matching the moon in the user's MOST RECENT attached screenshot. Reconstruct the full circular moon hidden by the castle, retaining its illustrated Macintosh monochrome style: bright white disc, broad irregular FLAT gray-looking patches made from closely spaced tiny black stipple dots, scattered smaller stippled patches, loose fine stippling along the lower-left rim. Match the patch density and simple graphic appearance of the screenshot. No volumetric crater bowls, shaded spherical terrain, realistic NASA lunar geography or photographic surface. Also NOT a blank white disc: preserve substantial broad stippled patches in the upper half and left half as shown. Square canvas, complete unobstructed circle diameter 88% canvas, centered, genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the circle. No castle, trees, stars, sky, clouds, black background, outer glow, halo, frame, lettering or checkerboard. All the interior disc is opaque white with black marks; only exterior transparent. This moon will be placed behind a separate castle layer.
prompts.revision: Match user's supplied moon crop; retain flat stippled patches, avoid photographic relief.

prompts.name: ground-mist
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A separate flat horizontal ribbon of distant lake mist for a finely stippled monochrome Macintosh game landscape. Transparent PNG, 1536x1024. Mist occupies only y=450 to580, wide and VERY thin, near the ground, trailing off delicately at left and right. Draw a few long horizontal, almost parallel bands of extremely fine white stipple on transparent alpha: wisps of ground fog peeking above distant mountain ridges, no tall billows or cloud lobes, NO cumulus clouds, NO puffy cotton, NO sky clouds, NO photographic smoke, no gray airbrush blur. Highest mist band barely 30 pixels high, gaps between the wisps mostly transparent. Almost all canvas entirely transparent. This will be composited behind mountains, so use only pale white fine dots, denser at lower edges, fading into sparse isolated dots toward upper edges, with all gaps truly transparent. No black fill, no solid white mass. No moon, stars, trees, mountains, land, water, scenery, text, checkerboard or border. Genuine transparency.
prompts.revision: User: thin low mist behind the mountains as in v6, not high cloud shapes.
